question: How should the other two hands be positioned relative to the hiccup-thread and scissors-tip?
premises: The other two hands are the object of the action.
They should be made equal to the hiccup-thread.
The reference point is the tip of the scissors.
inference: The other two hands should be aligned equal to the hiccup-thread at the scissors-tip.
uncertainties: hikkāsūtra and kartaryāgre are technical iconometric terms
